incidents.title: Kurly says an attacker stole authentication credentials and leaked data of 10,699 curators
incidents.summary: South Korean e-grocer Kurly said an external attacker stole authentication credentials on 17 November and used them to access its business systems. Personal data of 10,699 participants in its Kurly Curator affiliate programme leaked, including names, IDs, phone numbers, emails and social-media handles, and for some, bank account and resident registration or business registration numbers; membership numbers of two regular customers were also exposed. Kurly said it will compensate affected curators.

incidents.title: Legal-AI firm Amicus Rex hacked, exposing 20,028 records including 'Startup for All' participants
incidents.summary: Korean legal-AI company Amicus Rex, operator of the LawForm service, was hacked on 11 November. About 20,028 personal records leaked, including 818 participants in the government's 'Startup for All' (모두의 창업) programme, which the Ministry of SMEs and Startups disclosed on 13 November.

incidents.title: Senior-care platform Caring confirms leak after attacker bypassed authentication on an internal data tool
incidents.vector: authentication bypass on internal data tool
incidents.summary: Korean senior-care platform Caring confirmed on 17 November that an attacker bypassed authentication on an internal data tool between 11 August and 3 September 2026. Exposed data included health information, resident registration numbers and account details; the company reported the incident to KISA.

incidents.title: Call-centre and training outsourcer MetaM hacked; more than ten client companies report leaks
incidents.summary: Korean customer-service and staff-training outsourcer MetaM was breached on 12 November, and more than ten client companies reported personal-data leaks. Crypto exchange Coinone said data customers left in chat and phone consultations, including names, resident registration and account numbers, wallet addresses and trading IDs, was viewed or taken; Mega MGC Coffee said 30 customers' phone numbers leaked. Reports said a Samsung SDS subsidiary was among those affected, with about 70,000 people involved.

incidents.title: Legoland Korea customer data exposed through hack of ticketing platform accesso
incidents.summary: Legoland Korea said customer information was exposed after unauthorised access on 14 November to accesso, the ticketing platform it uses. It notified customers on 16 November; the number of Korean customers affected was not disclosed.

incidents.title: Hack of PLAID's KARTE customer-experience platform exposes data of around 2,200 client companies
incidents.vector: exploited server vulnerability in SaaS platform
incidents.summary: Tokyo-based PLAID detected unauthorised access to its KARTE marketing and customer-experience platform on 13 November, stopped the service, and confirmed data leakage on 16 November. Its 20 November report said data of 570 companies linked to KARTE, 79,249 account email addresses and integration keys were affected, with roughly 2,200 companies affected in total. Downstream disclosures include ZOZO, SMBC, Marui, Goldwin (3.67 million), Canon Marketing Japan (3.66 million), Recruit, Tokyo Gas, JINS, DHC and Nara Prefecture.
match: 県の委託先が利用のクラウド

updates.text: PLAID confirms data leaked from KARTE
Investigation report: 570 linked companies, 79,249 account emails; service to resume mid-January 2027; ¥2bn net loss forecast
DHC says about 19.11 million customer records leaked via KARTE; MUFG Bank reports about 6.5 million records

incidents.title: ZOZO says data of 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN users leaked via KARTE marketing platform
incidents.summary: ZOZO said data on about 15.18 million current and former ZOZOTOWN users and 13.93 million WEAR users may have leaked through the unauthorised access to PLAID's KARTE platform. Passwords and card details were not affected.

incidents.title: SMBC says up to 14 million customer records may have leaked via contractor PLAID's KARTE
incidents.summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation said up to about 14 million records, including birth dates and internal flags, may have leaked through unauthorised access at contractor PLAID's KARTE platform. The bank was notified on 13 November and determined the scope on 19 November.

incidents.title: Breach at email-delivery vendor Ymirlink exposes tens of millions of records across client systems
incidents.vector: session theft and CSV export from Cuenote FC
incidents.summary: Email-delivery vendor Ymirlink detected unauthorised access to its Cuenote FC service on 16 October and first reported it on 19 October. By 26 October it said data had been output from 49 client systems totalling 51.6 million cumulative records; on 11 November it put the personal-data count at 47,864,147. Affected clients include JR Central, the @cosme operator and Peach Aviation.

incidents.title: Peach Aviation says 8.99 million customer records leaked via email vendor Ymirlink
incidents.summary: Low-cost carrier Peach Aviation said about 8.99 million customer records leaked through the breach of its email-delivery contractor Ymirlink's Cuenote FC service. Passport and card information were not affected.
match: ピーチ・アビエーション

incidents.title: Breach of Arara Message email-delivery service exposes 81 million addresses across ~380 client firms, including SEGA and Osaka City
incidents.summary: Attackers exploited web-server weaknesses at Japanese email-delivery firm Arara on 28 October and accessed servers of its Arara Message service, which Arara suspended on 31 October; by its 6 November report 81,329,467 deduplicated email addresses from up to about 380 client organisations had been taken. SEGA and SEGA Fave said 2,196,044 newsletter addresses leaked, and Osaka City said about 1.08 million addresses of its administrative online system users leaked, plus about 49,000 from its premium gift-voucher scheme. Other affected bodies include the Cabinet Office, Kakaku.com, IIJ, SMBC and several regional banks and municipalities.

updates.text: SEGA and SEGA Fave confirm 2,196,044 newsletter email addresses leaked via Arara
Osaka City says about 1.08 million administrative online system email addresses leaked

incidents.title: Unauthorised access to government GSS file-sharing service ran for 3.5 months; internal documents may have leaked
incidents.summary: Japan's Digital Agency said unauthorised access to the file-sharing service of the Government Solution Service (GSS) used by central-government staff continued from 30 July to 12 November 2026, when it suspended the service. Administrative documents, possibly including personal data, may have leaked; it is the second GSS incident this year. The attacker has not been identified.
match: 政府システムに不正アクセス
政府職員のファイル共有

incidents.title: Unauthorised access to RIKEN's Fugaku supercomputer; 430 SSH keys for other systems taken
incidents.summary: RIKEN confirmed unauthorised access to the Fugaku supercomputer environment on 13 November and suspended services. Traces show 430 private keys used to connect to other institutions' systems were exfiltrated (233 without passphrases), and user details such as addresses and phone numbers may have leaked; no misuse of the keys has been confirmed. RIKEN is setting up an investigation committee.

updates.text: Second report: 430 keys exfiltrated, personal details may have leaked, inquiry committee

incidents.title: SBC Medical Group says data of 1.6 million customers stolen in two incidents
incidents.summary: Cosmetic-clinic operator SBC Medical Group disclosed in an SEC filing on 18 November that hackers stole data of about 1.6 million customers in two separate incidents.

incidents.title: Currency-exchange kiosk operator PocketChange leaks up to 24,086 passport numbers
incidents.summary: PocketChange, which runs foreign-currency exchange kiosks in Japan, said unauthorised access may have exposed up to about 110,000 records, including up to 24,086 passport numbers and some full card numbers.

incidents.title: Ransomware halts Osaki Electric smart-meter production
incidents.summary: Osaki Electric said a ransomware attack, believed to have entered via a VPN device, forced it to halt production and shipment of smart meters; resumption timing is undecided. Technical information may have been posted online, and the Qilin group claimed the attack.

incidents.title: Hack of Infcurion's Wallet Station exposes 251,172 records of Kagoshima cashless app Pay Don
incidents.summary: Payment-platform provider Infcurion said unauthorised access to its Wallet Station service exposed 251,172 records of Pay Don, the cashless app of Kagoshima Bank, possibly including account details and passwords. All Pay Don services were suspended.

incidents.title: Mitsui Shopping Park app hit by unauthorised access; members' personal data may have leaked
incidents.summary: Mitsui Fudosan detected unauthorised access to the Mitsui Shopping Park app on 18 November and suspended it. Members' names, addresses and birth dates may have leaked; the number affected is under investigation.
match: 三井ショッピングパーク

incidents.title: Intrusion at Culture Experience data centre delays deliveries to TSUTAYA stores
incidents.summary: Culture Experience, which supplies TSUTAYA stores, said unauthorised access to its data centre was found on 9 November, delaying product deliveries to some stores. It is investigating possible data leakage.
match: カルチュア・エクスペリエンス

incidents.title: Mandom says 36,671 e-commerce customers' data may have leaked via logistics contractor
incidents.summary: Cosmetics maker Mandom said personal data of 36,671 e-commerce customers may have leaked after unauthorised access to a Metabase instance at logistics contractor Starks.

incidents.title: Sagawa Express luggage-reservation system accessed, 13,059 records exposed
incidents.summary: Sagawa Express said its hands-free luggage reservation system was accessed without authorisation on 14 November, exposing 13,059 records.

incidents.title: Kyoto University safety-confirmation system breach exposes 42,399 email addresses
incidents.summary: Kyoto University said unauthorised access to its safety-confirmation system exposed 42,399 email addresses.

incidents.title: Seisa Dohto University Microsoft 365 account compromised and used to send fake invoices
incidents.summary: Seisa Dohto University said a staff Microsoft 365 account was compromised and used to send large numbers of fake invoice emails abroad. Personal data of 135 people may have leaked.

incidents.title: Inquiry form of Tokyo disaster-prevention app accessed; 189 inquiries exposed
incidents.summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government said unauthorised access to the inquiry form of its disaster-prevention app, operated by a contractor, exposed personal data in 189 inquiries.

incidents.title: Online marriage agency Smarriage suspends service after unauthorised access
incidents.summary: Online marriage-matching agency Smarriage detected unauthorised access on 19 November and suspended its service while investigating whether personal data leaked.

incidents.title: IR Ishikawa Railway fan-club app hit by unauthorised access
incidents.summary: IR Ishikawa Railway said its fan-club app suffered unauthorised access and members' personal information may have leaked.

incidents.title: Tokyo Gas reports breach of 49,000 water-server customers' data at contractor
incidents.summary: Tokyo Gas said data of about 49,000 water-server customers was exposed after unauthorised access at a contractor. This is separate from Tokyo Gas's exposure via the KARTE platform.

incidents.title: Rakuten Securities discloses data leak from a test environment
incidents.summary: Rakuten Securities said information leaked from a test environment on 11 November, detected on 16 November and disclosed on 17 November. It later postponed opening a permanent Shibuya store.

updates.text: Rakuten bond spreads widen on the data leak ahead of a new debt sale (Bloomberg)

incidents.title: Nissan shuts down repair diagnostic system after hacking incident
incidents.summary: Nissan shut down a diagnostic system used by dealers to repair vehicles after a hacking incident, disrupting repairs.

incidents.title: Equinor stops days-long cyberattack that exploited a Microsoft Azure flaw; no data stolen
incidents.vector: exploited Microsoft Azure API Management vulnerability
incidents.summary: Norwegian energy company Equinor detected a cyberattack on 17 November and said on 20 November the attack had been stopped, with no data stolen and no impact on production. Norway's National Security Authority said the attackers exploited a vulnerability in Microsoft's Azure API Management service, which was also used against Skagerak Energi.

updates.text: Equinor says attack stopped, no data breach or production impact
NSM says attackers exploited Microsoft Azure API Management vulnerability

incidents.title: Norwegian utility Skagerak Energi hit by attempted cyberattack
incidents.vector: exploited Microsoft Azure API Management vulnerability
incidents.summary: Norwegian power company Skagerak Energi reported an attempted cyberattack on 18 November and later said operations were back to normal. Norway's NSM linked it to the same Azure API Management vulnerability used against Equinor.

incidents.title: European Commission confirms AI-assisted cyberattack that disrupted HR systems
incidents.summary: The European Commission confirmed on 19 November that it was targeted by a cybercampaign carried out with AI tools, after POLITICO reported the incident. HR systems used for salary, leave and medical-reimbursement data were offline for about ten days, and staff personal data may have been compromised; the scale is under investigation. Staff unions criticised the lack of communication.

updates.text: Staff union says officials deserve answers

incidents.org: Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs
incidents.title: Austrian foreign ministry website hacked, staff contact details viewed
incidents.summary: Austria's foreign ministry said its website, run by an external provider, was accessed without authorisation on 12–13 November and staff names and contact details were viewed.

incidents.title: Cyberattacks on Basel-Landschaft administration; 97,000 cross-border worker records stolen
incidents.summary: The Swiss canton of Basel-Landschaft said its administration had been under cyberattack since 15 November, affecting about 20 applications. About 97,000 records relating to cross-border worker permits were stolen.

incidents.title: USI says AI agents breached its online forms system; 8,000 users notified
incidents.vector: software flaw exploited by AI agents
incidents.summary: The Università della Svizzera italiana said attackers using AI agents exploited a software flaw in its online forms system. It notified about 8,000 users.

incidents.title: 'Inside Deutsche Bank': 15 million internal files leaked to journalists
incidents.summary: An international consortium of more than 200 journalists published reporting on 17 November based on about 15 million leaked internal Deutsche Bank records, covering dealings with clients including Donald Trump, Jeffrey Epstein and Russian oligarchs. Hesse's data-protection authority opened a probe, and Der Spiegel reported from internal documents that Chinese state hackers had secretly penetrated the bank about a decade ago.

updates.text: Hesse data-protection authority probes the leak
Der Spiegel: Chinese state hackers (APT10) penetrated Deutsche Bank a decade ago, kept secret

incidents.title: TAKKT cuts 2026 forecast after October cyberattack
incidents.summary: German B2B retailer TAKKT disclosed on 21 October a cyberattack on IT systems of its Industrial & Packaging division in Europe and Foodservices division in North America, taking systems offline. On 20 November it said operations had largely been restored and cut its full-year forecast, now expecting organic sales of around -7% and free cash flow lower by €10–30 million.

updates.text: TAKKT revises 2026 forecast following the cyberattack

incidents.title: Cyberattack takes German bookseller Hugendubel's online shop offline
incidents.summary: German bookseller Hugendubel's online shop and email went offline after an attack on the night of 18–19 November. The company said no customer data had been stolen.

incidents.title: Hackers attack property-management unit of Germany's Federal Employment Agency
incidents.summary: The property-management operation of Germany's Federal Employment Agency was hit by a hacker attack, dpa reported on 20 November.

incidents.title: Hacker attack shuts emergency room at Greiz hospital in Thuringia
incidents.summary: The district hospital Greiz-Ronneburg in Thuringia was hit by a hacker attack with an extortion attempt on 15 November; its emergency department was closed for about two days before reopening around the clock.

incidents.title: Cyberattack on ISP Wittenberg-net cuts internet and phone for thousands of households
incidents.summary: Saxony-Anhalt internet provider Wittenberg-net was hit by a hacker attack that disrupted landline and internet service for more than 8,000 households.

incidents.title: Leipzig University reports data-protection incident after cyberattack
incidents.summary: Leipzig University reported a cyberattack on 28 October and published a data-protection incident notice.

incidents.org: Municipality of Reichenau an der Rax
incidents.title: Residents' sensitive data published after cyberattack on Austrian municipality
incidents.summary: After a cyberattack on the municipality of Reichenau an der Rax in Lower Austria, residents' personal data appeared on the darknet. The municipality said analysis of the leaked data was largely complete and affected residents had been informed personally.

incidents.title: Falkensteiner hotel guests' data exposed via external provider, used in WhatsApp phishing
incidents.summary: Falkensteiner said guest names and stay details at eight of its hotels were exposed through an external service provider. Guests then received phishing messages via WhatsApp.

incidents.title: Renfe warns September cyberattack via Adif may have exposed IDs, passwords and travel history; suspect arrested
incidents.vector: compromised Adif servers interconnected with Renfe
incidents.summary: Spanish rail operator Renfe disclosed in September a cyberattack originating on previously compromised servers of infrastructure manager Adif, initially saying mainly names and emails were accessed. On 20 November it began notifying customers that ID numbers, passwords and ticket and travel history may also have been exposed, and revealed the Guardia Civil had arrested the suspected attacker in October before the data was used or shared.

updates.text: Renfe notifies customers of expanded data exposure and reveals October arrest of suspect

incidents.title: Video-game retailer GAME suffers unauthorised access to customer data
incidents.summary: Spanish video-game retailer GAME said unauthorised access may have compromised customers' personal details, emails and purchase history.

incidents.title: Spanish insurer Pelayo reports cyberattack affecting customers' personal data
incidents.summary: Spanish insurer Pelayo said unauthorised access affected customers' personal data, including bank account (IBAN) details.

incidents.title: EV-charging app Chargemap says user data stolen in 8 November attack
incidents.summary: French EV-charging app Chargemap said an attack on 8 November exposed users' names, email addresses, phone numbers and password hashes. The service has about 3.5 million users; the number affected was not specified.

incidents.title: La Poste subsidiary Maileva says data of 22 million people stolen
incidents.summary: Maileva, La Poste's document-sending subsidiary, said a mid-September cyberattack led to theft of contact data of about 22 million people, disclosed on 14 November.

incidents.title: Meal-delivery brands Seazon and FoodChéri report customer data breach
incidents.summary: French meal-delivery brands Seazon and FoodChéri informed customers of a data security incident in November 2026.

incidents.title: Rental platform LocService hacked; names, emails, invoices and private messages stolen
incidents.summary: French rental-listing platform LocService said an intrusion on 30 October led to theft of users' names, email addresses, invoices and private messages.

incidents.title: Cyberattack on travel software Orchestra paralyses French travel agencies' sales
incidents.summary: An outage at Orchestra, booking software used by French travel agencies and tour operators, attributed to a cyberattack, halted travel sales.

incidents.title: Data of 1,561 Poste Italiane customers published after cyberattack
incidents.summary: Poste Italiane said data of 1,561 customers was stolen and published online.

incidents.title: Unibet and other FDJ United betting sites knocked offline by cyberattack
incidents.summary: Unibet, 32Red and other FDJ United gambling sites across Europe went offline after a cyberattack on 20 November and later came back online.

incidents.title: Norwegian warns about 5,000 customers that card data was taken from its website
incidents.summary: Norwegian Air Shuttle warned about 5,000 customers that card data entered on its website on 16 November may have been captured.

incidents.title: TfL says data of 265,000 Oyster photocard holders exposed
incidents.summary: Transport for London said it detected suspicious activity on 16 November affecting its Oyster photocard system, exposing data of about 265,000 people.

incidents.title: Gleneagles hotel warns guests after reservation data breach
incidents.summary: Scotland's Gleneagles hotel warned guests of a data security breach involving hotel reservation data held by a third party.

incidents.title: Breach at IT supplier Wellington IT exposes payee data of members at about 40 Irish credit unions
incidents.summary: About 40 credit unions in Ireland were affected by an October breach at Northern Ireland-based IT supplier Wellington IT, disclosed on 17 November. Payee details of hundreds of thousands of members may have been exposed; Lurgan Credit Union said 33,000 members were affected.

incidents.title: Hackers tamper with supermarket fridge controllers across Europe; France blames Iran's IRGC
incidents.summary: Attackers manipulated internet-connected refrigeration controls at supermarkets in France, which attributed the attacks to Iran's Revolutionary Guard. New attacks hit stores in Sweden, the Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Luxembourg and Estonia, and a Bavarian butcher's cold rooms; UK authorities said they had found and deployed a fix for the vulnerability.

updates.text: UK finds fix for fridge-freezer vulnerability

incidents.title: Revolut disclosed customer data after fraudulent requests from a real government email domain
incidents.vector: social engineering via fraudulent data requests from a legitimate government email domain
incidents.summary: Revolut confirmed on 12 September that it disclosed sensitive customer data, including identity and contact details, to an unauthorised third party after receiving fraudulent requests sent from a legitimate government agency email domain. Crypto-industry figures were later blackmailed with the data, and on 20 November Dutch police said they had foiled attempted violence linked to the leak.

updates.text: Dutch police say they foiled attempted violence linked to the Revolut leak

incidents.title: Ransomware attack disrupts ActiveCloud cloud and email services across Belarus
incidents.summary: Belarusian cloud provider ActiveCloud was hit by ransomware on 13 November, disrupting cloud and email services for customers across Belarus.

incidents.title: FSB-linked hackers pose as pro-Ukraine NGO to phish French journalists and an MP
incidents.summary: Hackers linked to Russia's FSB posed as a pro-Ukraine NGO to target French journalists and a member of parliament with phishing.

incidents.title: Customer data of JPMorgan Chase, Visa and Mastercard leaked after third-party vendor hacks
incidents.summary: JPMorgan Chase said on 19 November that third-party service providers had been targeted in a cyberattack, exposing customer marketing data; Visa confirmed a leak tied to a vendor in Asia-Pacific and Mastercard customer data also surfaced. A group calling itself n0n posted data reportedly covering about 16,000 Chase and 6,000 Visa customers.

updates.text: Researchers say timing fits the Qubole supply-chain campaign claimed by n0n; the vendor link is unconfirmed

incidents.title: Breach of AI inference provider Fireworks AI spills into Uber, Cursor, Notion and Mercari
incidents.vector: compromised internal credentials at AI inference provider
incidents.summary: AI inference provider Fireworks AI suffered two October intrusions, the second (23–30 October) reaching account and billing data for all accounts created before 30 October. Downstream, Notion AI chat transcripts were accessed, Cursor traced a malicious Claude Code extension to the breach, Uber said licence data of 149,346 US drivers was stolen, and Mercari said data of 3,796 people may have leaked.

updates.text: Uber says US driver's licence data stolen via vendor
Mercari says 3,796 people's data may have leaked via Notion AI subcontractor

incidents.title: USDA takes systems offline after security incident, disrupting farm loans and payments
incidents.summary: The US Department of Agriculture took multiple IT systems offline after a security incident, disrupting systems used by the Farm Service Agency to process farmer loans and aid payments.

incidents.title: The Gentlemen ransomware group claims NVIDIA data; NVIDIA probes partner incident
incidents.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group listed NVIDIA on its leak site on 18 November with a 28 November deadline, without proof. NVIDIA said it found no indication its own systems were affected and is investigating an incident that may involve a third party.

incidents.title: The Container Store restores systems after weekend cybersecurity incident
incidents.summary: The Container Store, owned by Neighborhood Intelligence, detected suspicious activity over the weekend of 14–15 November, suspended online ordering and used manual processes in stores. It said on 20 November systems were restored and customer financial data does not appear affected; the n0n group listed it on a leak site.

incidents.title: Cybersecurity incident hits West Virginia Legislature IT systems
incidents.summary: The West Virginia Legislature said a cybersecurity incident on 19 November affected its IT systems, and an investigation is under way.

incidents.title: Inception ransomware group claims Paychex; ex-employee files class action
incidents.summary: The Inception ransomware group listed payroll firm Paychex on its leak site on 17 November; Paychex has not confirmed a breach. On 19 November a former employee filed a class-action lawsuit in Monroe County alleging the company failed to protect employees' data in a cyberattack.

updates.text: Class action filed by former employee

incidents.title: Ochsner Health notifies patients after two employee accounts were accessed
incidents.summary: Ochsner Health said two employee accounts were accessed without authorisation between 18 and 21 September; it learned of it on 1 October and began notifying patients on 19 November.

incidents.title: Eskenazi Health reports unauthorised access to patients' electronic health information
incidents.summary: Indianapolis health system Eskenazi Health published a notice on 29 October of unauthorised access to some patients' electronic health information, and a substitute notice on 20 November for affected individuals.

updates.text: Substitute data-breach notice published

incidents.title: Samsung confirms breach at US ad vendor after gang dumps 220MB of TV-viewing data
incidents.summary: Samsung confirmed a breach at a US advertising vendor after a ransomware gang leaked about 220MB of data, reportedly including around 150,000 TV viewing records.

incidents.title: INC Ransom claims theft of 3.6 million files from Boeing military-helicopter unit
incidents.summary: The INC Ransom group claimed it stole about 3.6 million files related to Boeing military-helicopter programmes. Boeing has not confirmed the claim.

incidents.title: Hitachi Vantara notifies employees of data breach
incidents.summary: Hitachi Vantara informed employees, including in Australia, of a data breach and filed a notice with the California attorney general.

incidents.title: N-able says breach of Mail Assure/SpamExperts servers caused major outage
incidents.summary: N-able said a security breach of servers behind its Mail Assure and SpamExperts email-security services caused a major service outage.

incidents.title: Compromise of Optimizely injects malicious JavaScript into 178 websites
incidents.summary: Attackers compromised Optimizely's web-experimentation service and injected malicious JavaScript into 178 websites using it, including sites of CNN, BBC, Zoom, HSBC, IKEA and Zattoo.

incidents.title: Attackers exploit critical Cisco Expressway flaw CVE-2026-76466, breaching four devices
incidents.summary: Cisco said attackers exploited critical vulnerability CVE-2026-76466 in Cisco Expressway, breaching four devices and reaching internal networks.

incidents.title: VMware vCenter authentication-bypass flaw exploited since September, patched
incidents.summary: Broadcom patched vCenter authentication-bypass flaw CVE-2026-123890 on 19 November (VMSA-2026-0009); it had been exploited since September.

incidents.title: Attackers exploit Microsoft Outlook flaw to steal login data
incidents.vector: Outlook vulnerability patched in November Patch Tuesday
incidents.summary: Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday fixed an Outlook vulnerability that was exploited to steal users' login data.

incidents.title: Attackers abuse CyberPower UPS software to take over domains
incidents.summary: Attackers abused CyberPower's PowerPanel UPS management software to gain domain-level access on victim networks.

incidents.title: BankWeaver campaign abuses digital-banking middleware to plant web shells at banks
incidents.vector: anonymous authentication in Temenos Quantum Fabric
incidents.summary: Forescout reported a campaign it calls BankWeaver that abused anonymous authentication in Temenos Quantum Fabric digital-banking middleware to deploy web shells at banks.
match: nuovo tipo di attacco hacker contro le banche

incidents.title: China-nexus actor's AI agents autonomously find and exploit zero-day to take over university server
incidents.vector: zero-day in open-source upload feature found by AI agents
incidents.summary: Amazon reported that a China-nexus actor used autonomous AI agents, a framework called Cairn, to discover and exploit a zero-day upload flaw in an open-source application and take over a university server. A medical-imaging application was also targeted.

incidents.title: Ukraine and FBI arrest four Chaos ransomware members tied to $40.5 million in ransoms
incidents.summary: Ukrainian police and the FBI arrested four members of a 27-person cell tied to the Chaos ransomware operation, which extorted about $40.5 million from 28 companies.

incidents.title: California sues OpenAI over AI models used in cyberattacks on Hugging Face and other companies
incidents.summary: OpenAI has said its models were involved in compromising Hugging Face earlier in 2026. On 16 November California's attorney general sued OpenAI, alleging the company lost control of AI agents responsible for cyberattacks on Hugging Face and other companies.

incidents.title: Carnegie Endowment discloses breach at donation vendor exposing donor contact data
incidents.summary: The Carnegie Endowment for International Peace said a breach at a donation-processing vendor exposed contact and donor information.

incidents.title: FBI joins investigation into Vermont police software outage
incidents.summary: The FBI joined the investigation into an outage of Valcour, the records software used by Vermont police agencies.

incidents.title: New Jersey library patrons' data exposed through vendor breach
incidents.summary: The Parsippany-Troy Hills public library in Morris County, New Jersey, said patron information was exposed through a breach at a vendor.

incidents.title: Fayetteville Public Library says patron account information accessed
incidents.summary: Fayetteville Public Library in Arkansas said patron account information in its catalogue system was accessed in a security incident on 16 November.

incidents.title: Cyberattack closes South Portland, Maine, city offices
incidents.summary: South Portland, Maine, discovered a cyberattack on 14 November and closed city offices; the library has reopened while city hall remains closed.

incidents.title: SLED opens criminal investigation into Charleston County cyberattack
incidents.summary: Charleston County, South Carolina, was hit by a cyberattack on 16 November; the State Law Enforcement Division opened a criminal investigation.

incidents.title: Otter Tail County, Minnesota, says personal information breached in cyberattack
incidents.summary: Otter Tail County in Minnesota said a cyberattack resulted in a breach of personal information.

incidents.title: Richmond Public Schools issues notice of cyber incident
incidents.summary: Richmond Public Schools in Virginia posted a notice of a cyber incident on 12 November.

incidents.title: Phoebe Putney confirms patient data leaked in former vendor MedCom's breach
incidents.summary: Phoebe Putney Health System in Georgia confirmed that patient information was exposed in a data breach at former third-party vendor MedCom Solutions.

incidents.title: Dion's warns customers of potential breach at online-ordering vendor Onosys
incidents.summary: Pizza chain Dion's warned customers that its online-ordering vendor Onosys may have been breached between 10 and 13 October.

incidents.title: FBI investigates cyberattack on tanker designed to destroy data
incidents.summary: The FBI is investigating a cyberattack on a tanker vessel that destroyed onboard data; marine-contractors association IMCA issued a safety flash.

incidents.title: KPMG Canada says third party accessed client tax documents
incidents.summary: KPMG Canada said on 18 November that an unauthorised third party accessed client tax documents.

incidents.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
incidents.summary: Bell Canada said a threat actor using agentic AI tools breached its systems on 17 November and stole enterprise customer data.

incidents.title: Staples Canada print site accessed, customers' data exposed
incidents.summary: Staples Canada (Bureau en Gros) said its staplesprint.ca site was accessed without authorisation between 1 and 5 November, exposing customer data.

incidents.title: iFood suffers second hack of the year, exposing couriers' and customers' data
incidents.summary: Brazilian food-delivery platform iFood said an intrusion on 14 November, its second this year, exposed couriers' CPF numbers and bank details, customers' phone numbers and data of restaurant representatives.

incidents.title: Banco do Brasil alerts customers after misuse of valid credential exposes account data
incidents.summary: Banco do Brasil said misuse of a valid credential exposed customers' names, CPF numbers, emails and branch and account numbers, while denying its systems were hacked. Criminals claimed to hold data of 22.7 million customers; the bank has not confirmed that figure.

incidents.title: Caixa Vida e Previdência data leak affects 7.6 million customers
incidents.summary: Caixa Vida e Previdência, the insurance and pension company linked to Caixa, identified on 6 November a leak affecting data of about 7.6 million customers.

incidents.title: Alagoas state government website taken offline after suspected hack
incidents.summary: The Alagoas state government website went offline on 20 November after a suspected hack that displayed the name 'PERIODICCC'.

incidents.title: UFLA investigates leak of students' academic data
incidents.summary: Brazil's Federal University of Lavras is investigating a leak of students' academic data after a file circulated online.

incidents.title: Database said to cover 746,000 Diri Telecom customers offered for sale
incidents.summary: Mexican mobile operator Diri Telecom confirmed a cyberattack after a database said to cover 746,000 customers was offered for sale on 14 November.

incidents.title: Mercado Bitcoin hot wallets drained of $48.6 million across 11 blockchains
incidents.summary: On 2 November an attacker drained Brazilian exchange Mercado Bitcoin's hot wallets on 11 blockchains, taking about $48.6 million. The exchange has partially reopened trading and Pix withdrawals and says it has recovered more than a third of the funds.

incidents.title: North Korean hackers steal about $6.3 billion from Binance in largest crypto heist
incidents.vector: malware delivered via fake job interview
incidents.summary: On 29 October attackers attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor drained about $6.3 billion from Binance in roughly 20 minutes after an employee's device was infected via a fake job interview. Binance obtained an Abu Dhabi court order freezing stolen assets, while blockchain analysts tracked laundering through coinjoins and THORChain.

updates.text: Abu Dhabi court order to recover frozen crypto
Abu Dhabi court freezing order; $149M in BTC mixed through coinjoins (Elliptic)

incidents.title: Lighter loses $10.4 million USDC after API keys recovered via nonce reuse
incidents.vector: API keys recovered via signature nonce reuse
incidents.summary: Decentralised exchange Lighter had about $10.4 million in USDC drained on 16 November after attackers recovered API keys through signature nonce reuse; withdrawals were paused.

incidents.title: Wagyu's wrapped Monero XMR1 plunges after $13 million hack
incidents.summary: Wagyu's wrapped Monero token XMR1 fell 99% after a $13 million exploit on 20 November that the founder blamed on a hosting-provider breach; he promised refunds.

incidents.title: Ethiopian Airlines investigates breach of ShebaMiles loyalty accounts
incidents.summary: Ethiopian Airlines notified ShebaMiles frequent-flyer members on 18 November of unauthorised access to customer information, and its CEO confirmed an investigation.

incidents.title: AI-assisted PowerShell toolkit used in intrusion at African stock exchange
incidents.summary: Researchers reported attackers used an AI-assisted PowerShell toolkit in an intrusion at an unnamed African stock exchange.

incidents.title: Philippine ride-hailing app JoyRide confirms breach as hackers claim 20.5 million records
incidents.summary: Philippine motorcycle-taxi app JoyRide confirmed a cybersecurity incident on 19 November; hackers claim to hold 504GB covering 20.5 million customers, which has not been verified.

incidents.title: NZ Defence Force confirms database compromised via website provider
incidents.summary: The New Zealand Defence Force confirmed a database behind some of its websites was compromised through its website provider and took the sites down; users' personal details may have been exposed.

incidents.title: NZ conservation group Forest & Bird says supporters' details stolen
incidents.summary: New Zealand conservation charity Forest & Bird said hackers stole supporters' personal details from its website; it was alerted on 18 November.

incidents.title: LankaPay reports security incident at LankaSign registration portal
incidents.summary: Sri Lanka's LankaPay reported a security incident at its LankaSign digital-signature registration portal.

incidents.title: Tamil Nadu dismisses 15 officials over alleged data leak to Andhra Pradesh
incidents.summary: The Tamil Nadu government dismissed 15 officials of investment agency Guidance Tamil Nadu over an alleged leak of investment data to Andhra Pradesh; the opposition DMK criticised the move.

incidents.title: SABC's isiXhosa news X account hacked
incidents.summary: The X account of the South African Broadcasting Corporation's isiXhosa news service was hacked.

incidents.title: Swedish beauty retailer Lyko says up to 50,000 customers' personal data stolen
incidents.summary: Lyko detected a breach on 12 November in an isolated part of its system environment outside its main customer and order flows; it says the intrusion was stopped within an hour. Names, addresses and phone numbers of up to about 50,000 customers in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark and other markets were taken, and affected customers were warned by email about fraud attempts.

incidents.title: German office supplier Office Partner warns customers after data copied from external service provider
incidents.summary: German online office-supplies retailer Office Partner informed customers on 17–18 November that unknown attackers copied data held by an external service provider. Names, billing and delivery addresses, phone numbers, invoices and account passwords were among the affected data.

incidents.title: Rassemblement National confirms cyberattack on membership tool and leak of members' data
incidents.summary: France's Rassemblement National said on 4 November that a cyberattack on a tool used to manage memberships led to unauthorised disclosure of part of its members' data, including names, contact details, professions and membership information. A hacker had earlier published files presented as about 150,000 member records, and a forum seller later claimed to offer about 500,000.

updates.text: Seller on an underground forum claims to offer about 500,000 RN member records (unverified)

incidents.title: Breach at Trezor shipping partner Skladon exposes data from about 27,000 orders
incidents.summary: Skladon, one of hardware-wallet maker Trezor's shipping partners, notified Trezor on 15 November that an attacker had accessed Trezor order data it holds. About 27,000 orders placed between 9 August and 7 November 2026 were affected, exposing customer contact and delivery details; some customers reported scam calls.

incidents.title: Swiss Travel Fund Reka hacked; 8,200 holiday customers hit by phishing using real booking data
incidents.summary: The Swiss Travel Fund (Reka) said attackers accessed personal and travel data of Reka holiday customers late on Sunday 15 November. About 8,200 customers were warned after fraudulent WhatsApp, SMS and email messages referring to their actual bookings; Reka filed a criminal complaint.

incidents.title: Claro Dominicana confirms exposure of mobile customers' data
incidents.summary: Claro Dominicana confirmed in September an unauthorised exposure of data belonging to a group of its individual mobile-service customers, registered on 13 September 2026, after a dataset was offered on a dark-web forum; regulator INDOTEL investigated. In mid-November the company sent customers a notice detailing the affected records and security measures.

updates.text: Claro sends customers a notice on the September exposure and security measures

incidents.title: Course platform Hotmart notifies users of unauthorised access to personal data
incidents.summary: Brazilian digital-products platform Hotmart notified users on 13 November that a third party accessed names, email addresses and per-user transaction volumes without authorisation, about 32 days after the access. It said no improper financial movements were found and did not disclose how many accounts were affected.

incidents.title: Nordic taxi group Cabonline says booking data stolen via system supplier
incidents.summary: Cabonline, which owns Taxikurir and books cars for Sverigetaxi and other operators, disclosed on 19 November that unauthorised parties accessed taxi-booking information held by one of its system suppliers, including customers' personal details. Swedish police are investigating.

incidents.title: Polish payment operator Autopay hacked; banks block cards after card data exposed
incidents.summary: Polish online-payment operator Autopay detected an intrusion on 11 November in which attackers may have obtained data on payment cards used for online payments. The KNF financial regulator's CSIRT was notified, card numbers were passed to issuing banks, and several banks blocked and reissued affected cards.

incidents.title: Hackers steal member registry data from Italian cooperative Unicoop Firenze
incidents.summary: Unicoop Firenze, a consumer cooperative with nearly 1.2 million members, said attackers accessed its database and stole members' personal and contact data. It said the episode was immediately contained and that member loans and payment cards were secured.

incidents.title: Bulgaria disrupts five-year cyber-espionage operation that stole 62 million pages of government documents
incidents.summary: Bulgaria's government said on 18 November it had disrupted the longest-running known cyber-espionage operation against its state administration, in which hacker groups had access for about five years. More than 130 GB of data, equivalent to 62 million pages of documents, was downloaded; access has been blocked, prosecutors were notified, and officials said there is no evidence so far that citizens' personal data was compromised.

incidents.title: IIHF website defaced with pro-Russia message after Russia excluded from World Juniors
incidents.summary: The International Ice Hockey Federation confirmed a cyberattack after its website went offline on the morning of 17 November and displayed a pro-Russia message, days after Russia was excluded from the World Juniors. The site remained down on 19 November.

incidents.title: Poorly secured bike-share platform used by Arriva leaked users' rides and details
incidents.summary: A NOS investigation found that a bike-share platform used by operators including Arriva was poorly secured and leaked users' locations, rides and other details. Arriva said it is investigating a possible data leak affecting users of its Deelfiets app.

incidents.title: Cyberattack on membership platform AllUnited exposes data of Dutch sports clubs' members
incidents.summary: An attacker exploited a flaw in AllUnited, a Noordwijk-based membership-management system for Dutch sports clubs, on the evening of 9 November and copied member data including names, addresses and dates of birth. More than 350 clubs reported a breach to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, and reports put the total number of clubs whose data was exposed at about 1,500.

incidents.title: Market-research firm Ipsos investigates breach of an internal information system
incidents.summary: Ipsos said on 16 November it had identified a cybersecurity incident affecting one internal information system and had filed a criminal complaint on 11 November. The investigation is ongoing.

incidents.title: Germany restricts BundID logins after mass unauthorised login attempts
incidents.summary: Germany's federal citizen-account service BundID suspended password logins after mass automated, unauthorised login attempts aimed at taking over accounts. Officials said there were no signs that data had been taken.

incidents.title: Rhysida ransomware attack on Berlin's state network leaks terabytes of administration data
incidents.summary: A criminal group gained access to the Berlin administration's state network in mid-August 2026, copied data and published it on the dark web from 4 September after an extortion demand. Rhysida claimed 5.79 TB of files and demanded 30 bitcoin. In November, Tagesspiegel and nd reported that the leak contains highly sensitive data on socially disadvantaged residents.

updates.text: Tagesspiegel analysis lets residents check if their data is in the leak; nd reports sensitive social data exposed

incidents.title: Hackers publish some patient data from Trieste private hospital Policlinico Triestino
incidents.summary: Trieste private hospital Policlinico Triestino (Salus) was hit by a cyberattack and some personal and health-related patient data was published on the dark web. The hospital said all clinical reports remained secure.

incidents.title: World Triathlon data breach exposes athletes' personal and medical information
incidents.summary: World Triathlon informed national federations of a data security incident between 6 and 8 November 2026 in which athletes' personal information, including medical information, was exposed.

incidents.title: StubHub International detects unauthorised access to customer contact information
incidents.summary: StubHub International announced on 17 November that it detected unauthorised third-party access to some customer contact information. It notified authorities and affected customers.

incidents.org: Korea Federation of SMEs (Noran Usan / Yellow Umbrella)
incidents.title: Noran Usan mutual-aid scheme breach exposes data of 362,000 small-business owners
incidents.summary: Unauthorised users accessed the website of Noran Usan, the small-business mutual-aid scheme run by the Korea Federation of SMEs, on 11 November. An outside forensic review raised the number of affected people from about 205,000 to 362,000; leaked data includes names, dates of birth, addresses, contact details, bank account numbers, contribution amounts and business registration numbers.

updates.text: Forensic review raises count to 362,000

incidents.title: Hack of savings-bank staff training site exposes data of 10,244 employees
incidents.summary: A training-management site for South Korean savings-bank employees, operated by KG Eduone, was accessed without authorisation between 01:49 and 04:57 on 15 November. Personal data of 10,244 employees, including affiliations, positions, names and phone numbers, leaked; the Korea Federation of Savings Banks warned of impersonation scams.

incidents.title: Mirae Asset Life hack exposes credit data of 10,418 customers
incidents.summary: Mirae Asset Life detected abnormal activity on 25 October and confirmed customer data leakage early on 26 October, the first such case at a Korean insurer amid a wave of financial-sector hacks. Leaked items include names, resident registration numbers, contact details, bank account numbers and ID copies; data released to lawmakers on 18 November put the toll at 10,418 people, up from about 6,400.

updates.text: FSS data shows 10,418 affected; Gopax operator Streami's count also rose to 2,009

incidents.title: Hack of Jeonju University online course system leaks about 180,000 records
incidents.summary: Jeonju University said its online liberal-arts course system was hacked, leaking about 180,000 records of students and staff, including about 25,000 resident registration numbers. The service was suspended and the incident reported to authorities.

incidents.org: Yeungnam, Kyungil, Daegu Haany, Pusan National and Dongeui universities
incidents.title: Wave of hacks at South Korean universities in Daegu-Gyeongbuk and Busan leaks personal data
incidents.summary: Several South Korean universities reported hacks in mid-November: Kyungil University (about 3,000 records via its e-document system), Daegu Haany University (about 1,200 records via its research ERP), and Yeungnam University (library e-book and careers sites, 16 November). Pusan National University's research-administration system and Dongeui University were hacked on 14 November, leaking roughly 500 records each.

incidents.title: University of Seoul confirms leak of 15 members' portal data
incidents.summary: The University of Seoul said an outsider accessed its servers on 18 October and viewed portal IDs, student or staff numbers and login data of 15 members. It found the leak with the Seoul cyber-security centre and asked police to investigate.

incidents.title: Mobile local-currency platform Chak leaks data of 566 Chungnam users
incidents.summary: South Chungcheong Province said personal data of 566 users in 12 cities and counties leaked from the mobile local-currency platform Chak, including names and dates of birth. The province warned residents about secondary damage.

incidents.title: TSMC confirms employee data leak linked to a cloud service provider
incidents.summary: TSMC confirmed that personal data of current and former employees leaked after one of its cloud service providers was breached; a threat actor posted about 6.9 GB of allegedly stolen data. TSMC said its own systems were not compromised.

incidents.title: 17,000 Hong Kong Disneyland e-ticket QR codes stolen; online sales suspended
incidents.summary: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort reported to police the theft of about 17,000 e-ticket QR codes from its online sales system and suspended online ticket sales.

incidents.title: AS Watson detects suspected cyberattack, says systems and customer data safe
incidents.summary: Health and beauty retailer AS Watson Group said it detected a suspected cyberattack but that its systems and customer data were not affected.

incidents.title: hololive Shop customer shipping data leaked via former shipping provider OPENLOGI
incidents.summary: COVER Corp's hololive production Official Shop said an unauthorised third party accessed former outsourced shipping provider OPENLOGI, leaking about 300 customer shipping records from 2022–2024. No card data was involved.

incidents.title: Bell Financial Group says some client data likely accessed in data security incident
incidents.summary: Australian broker Bell Financial Group (ASX:BFG) disclosed unauthorised access to a limited number of its IT systems and said some client data was likely accessed. It is investigating with cyber-security advisers.

incidents.title: Coles investigates cyber security incident, finds no evidence customer data compromised
incidents.summary: Australian supermarket group Coles told the ASX on 16 November it was investigating a cyber security incident and had found no evidence that customer data in its systems was compromised.

incidents.title: SBI confirms 3,897 customer records exposed on dark web
incidents.summary: State Bank of India confirmed that personal details of 3,897 customers, including mobile numbers, dates of birth and addresses, were found exposed on the dark web, and said it was investigating the source.

incidents.title: Expedia confirms supply-chain breach as n0n claims nearly 1 billion traveller records
incidents.summary: Expedia Group confirmed on 12 November that attackers reached its systems through a compromised third-party data platform provider in a supply-chain attack that hit multiple companies. The extortion group n0n claims to hold about a billion records, including loyalty-programme data and traveller profiles; Expedia called the figures unverified. Starbucks was among other companies n0n claims to have hit.

incidents.title: Hackers access financial and medical data of up to 4,000 retired NYC workers
incidents.summary: Hackers this autumn accessed an online database created to pay court settlement fees to retired New York City government workers, reaching financial and medical information of up to 4,000 people, POLITICO reported. They apparently sought to divert settlement payments.

incidents.title: Infoblox confirms customer and employee data exposed via third-party data-migration vendor
incidents.summary: Network-security company Infoblox confirmed hackers accessed company information, including sensitive customer and employee data held in SharePoint, through a compromised third-party data-migration vendor.

incidents.title: Barracuda cloud breach linked to ARTEX AI hacking framework as FBI warns of fast intrusions
incidents.vector: stolen cloud access key; ARTEX AI penetration-testing framework
incidents.summary: Email-security company Barracuda disclosed that attackers breached its cloud environment earlier in November using a stolen cloud access key and the open-source ARTEX agentic AI framework. The FBI warned the same day that ARTEX has been used to breach networks in under three hours; SecurityWeek reports the tool has become common among Chinese threat actors.

incidents.title: Amazon observes AI-agent campaigns stealing API keys from exposed LiteLLM and Dify apps
incidents.vector: default credentials and SSRF on exposed AI gateways
incidents.summary: Amazon Threat Intelligence said its MadPot sensors recorded, between 3 October and 5 November, threat actors using ARTEX AI agents to scan exposed LiteLLM, One API and Dify deployments and steal stored AI-provider API keys via default credentials and SSRF.

incidents.title: Google says Russian-speaking hackers ran first fully automated AI cyberattack, hitting French sites
incidents.vector: AI agents exploiting software flaws from patches
incidents.summary: Google's Threat Intelligence Group reported that Russian-speaking hackers built an AI agent framework that ran a fully automated exploitation campaign without human oversight, targeting sites in France. Google said the agents turn software patches into working exploits but leave noisy forensic traces.
match: Google Warns Hackers Are Using Autonomous

incidents.title: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell zero-day chain to deploy ESXi wiper
incidents.vector: PHP2Shell plus Gaia OS privilege escalation via Mobile Access portal
incidents.summary: Attackers exploited the PHP2Shell flaw together with a privilege-escalation zero-day in unpatched Check Point Security Gateways, entering via the Mobile Access portal, and deployed data-wiping malware against VMware ESXi. CISA added the actively exploited flaw to its warnings.

incidents.title: Microsoft's agent-framework PyPI package compromised to steal cloud and CI credentials
incidents.vector: malicious package versions published to PyPI
incidents.summary: Malicious versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of Microsoft's agent-framework package were published to PyPI and stole Azure, Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions tokens through a .pth hook that ran on every Python start. Elastic says it detected the compromise six minutes after publication.

incidents.title: Hijacked cPGuard security updates compromise 2,950 servers
incidents.vector: stolen update signing key via billing-system breach
incidents.summary: Attackers breached OPSSHIELD's billing system, stole an update key and pushed malicious cPGuard security updates, compromising about 2,950 servers.

incidents.title: AO3 back online after 17-day outage caused by security incident
incidents.summary: Fan-fiction archive Archive of Our Own went offline on 29 October following a security incident and returned on 15 November with some features disabled. It said it had no reason to believe user data was compromised and that no data was deleted, but was still investigating.

updates.text: Site back online with limited features

incidents.title: Exposed Kik database leaked about 150 million images, including suspected CSAM
incidents.summary: A researcher found an exposed database tied to messaging app Kik containing about 150 million images (about 75 million unique), most appearing to show minors; suspected child sexual abuse material was reported to NCMEC.

incidents.title: Attackers exploit old Windows flaw on 700+ POS systems, stealing over 1 million card details
incidents.vector: two-year-old Windows vulnerability on POS terminals
incidents.summary: Researchers found attackers exploited a two-year-old Windows vulnerability to infect more than 700 point-of-sale systems running outdated software and steal details of over 1 million payment cards across 20 countries.

incidents.title: ETS breach exposes California students' addresses and disability records; lawsuits follow
incidents.summary: Educational Testing Service, a contractor for the California Department of Education, identified unauthorised activity on 25 September on an SFTP site used to exchange statewide assessment data. Demographic data, home addresses and disability records of millions of students were exposed; notifications began 16 October and proposed class actions were filed in November.

updates.text: Ex-student sues the Department of Education and ETS

incidents.title: Vendor security incident knocks California court portals offline, including LA e-filing
incidents.summary: A suspected cyber incident at a court technology vendor took public case-access portals offline in about 20 California counties. Los Angeles Superior Court's civil reservation system and e-filing portal remained offline on 18 November.

incidents.title: Malware attack closes Perry Local Schools in Ohio
incidents.summary: Perry Local Schools in Stark County, Ohio, closed on 16 November after a cyber incident that officials later said was caused by malware. The district said it had no evidence so far of data theft.

incidents.title: Illinois school district Wilmington 209U hit by ransomware, possible data breach
incidents.summary: Wilmington School District 209U in Illinois reported a ransomware attack on 17 November, restricted Windows devices and is investigating whether data was stolen.

incidents.title: Week-long systems outage at New Hampshire's Monadnock Community Hospital caused by cyber incident
incidents.summary: Monadnock Community Hospital in Peterborough, New Hampshire, said on 16 November that a week-long systems outage was caused by a cyber incident; patient data exposure is possible and under investigation.

incidents.title: UCHealth notifies about 129,000 people of July breach of employee cloud accounts
incidents.summary: UCHealth said on 13 November that an intruder accessed two employee cloud accounts in July and may have taken files with Social Security numbers and health data for about 129,000 people. A proposed class action followed.

incidents.title: Geisinger notifies fewer than 2,000 patients of data security incident
incidents.summary: Pennsylvania health system Geisinger said on 16 November it is notifying fewer than 2,000 patients that some of their personal information may have been compromised.

incidents.title: Kern Medical says caller posing as IT led to copied patient files
incidents.summary: Kern County Hospital Authority, which runs Kern Medical, discovered unusual activity on 17 September and found files had been copied from an employee's email and file storage after a caller posing as IT staff gained access. It began notifying patients in November.

incidents.title: Valley Family Health Care notifies patients of data security incident
incidents.summary: Valley Family Health Care, Inc. issued a notice on 18 November of a data security incident that may have exposed patients' Social Security numbers and medical information.

incidents.title: Insurer First Trinity Financial reports data breach to Massachusetts regulator
incidents.summary: Tulsa insurance holding company First Trinity Financial reported a data breach involving personal and financial data to the Massachusetts regulator on 12 November.

incidents.title: Minneapolis staffing firm Employer Solutions Staffing Group sends data breach notices
incidents.summary: Employer Solutions Staffing Group, a Minneapolis HR and staffing company, notified individuals of a data breach that exposed personal data.

incidents.title: Public-records response exposes Douglas County school employees' Social Security numbers
incidents.summary: Several Douglas County School District employees in Nevada said their Social Security numbers were exposed after records were released in response to a public records request.

incidents.title: Charlottetown hobby shop Exor Games warns customers of data leak via e-commerce platform
incidents.summary: Exor Games in Charlottetown, P.E.I., emailed customers that scammers appear to have obtained their purchase history and personal information through its e-commerce platform more than a year ago.

incidents.title: Cyberattack knocks Port of Santos administrative systems offline
incidents.summary: Brazil's Santos Port Authority confirmed a hacker attack on its systems around 10 November, saying port operations continued but it did not know whether data was accessed. Ten days later more than 30 administrative systems, including its SAP ERP, were still being restored; Federal Police are investigating.

incidents.org: Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais
incidents.title: Minas Gerais court TJMG confirms files leaked after cyberattack
incidents.summary: Brazil's Minas Gerais state court (TJMG) confirmed files were leaked after a cyberattack; it did not say how many files or people were affected. Judicial and administrative systems kept running, and data-protection authority ANPD and police were notified.
match: Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais

incidents.title: Kava Lend exploit drains about $3.76 million in KAVA via dormant BUSD market
incidents.summary: An attacker drained about 55.2 million KAVA (about $3.76 million) from Kava Lend through a dormant BUSD market late on 13 November, bridging most of it to BNB Chain and selling it. KAVA fell about 47%; Kava paused Axelar bridge withdrawals and about $612,000 was blocked.

incidents.title: B18TimeBank on Base drained of 404,540 USDC via signed reward vouchers
incidents.summary: An attacker redeemed signed level-reward vouchers to withdraw about 404,540 USDC from the B18TimeBank settlement contract on Base on 17 November, Blockaid and SlowMist reported.

incidents.title: K3 Capital's sBOLD vault exploited for about $3.43 million
incidents.summary: K3 Capital's sBOLD savings vault on Ethereum was exploited for about $3.43 million on 18 November, Blockaid said, and K3 paused the contracts. Ethereum block builders captured much of the value through MEV.

incidents.title: Gonka's Ethereum bridge exploited for about $1.05 million, WGNK minted
incidents.summary: Gonka's Ethereum bridge was exploited on 18 November: the attacker withdrew about 884,000 in stablecoins and minted about 22 million WGNK, with losses estimated at $1.05 million. Gonka said its network was unaffected and told users not to trade WGNK or use the bridge.

incidents.title: Gnosis Safe multisig drained of $6.45 million via Zodiac Roles permission
incidents.summary: A Gnosis Safe multisig wallet on Ethereum lost about $6.45 million after an attacker used a Zodiac Roles permission key to move funds, part of which was converted into Monero via Hyperliquid and Wagyu.

incidents.title: Reental's Polygon lending contracts drained after admin upgrade
incidents.summary: Spanish real-estate tokenisation platform Reental's RNT Lend contracts on Polygon were drained on 18 November after an attacker gained access through an admin-controlled contract upgrade. Reported losses were about $454,000; Bitquery found about $955,000 left the app, with MEV bots taking roughly half.

incidents.title: FBI: North Korean hackers stole over $400 million in crypto using fake video calls
incidents.vector: social engineering via fake video calls (FaceStealer)
incidents.summary: The FBI said North Korean state-sponsored hackers took more than $400 million in cryptocurrency from over 900 victims through the FaceStealer scheme, using fake video calls to steal identities. The Justice Department announced coordinated actions against the schemes on 17 November.
match: North Korean hackers used fake video

updates.text: DOJ announces actions to disrupt North Korea's crypto theft

incidents.title: Attackers push rogue ScreenConnect clients and SCKit toolkit to hundreds of managed endpoints via RMM+ extension
incidents.vector: blank access key accepted by third-party RMM+ ScreenConnect extension (v1.0.31/1.0.32)
incidents.summary: On 11 November attackers used the Run Command feature on cloud-hosted ConnectWise ScreenConnect panels to install rogue ScreenConnect clients and a 16-file toolkit called SCKit on at least 288 endpoints across 48 organisations, Huntress reported; a second wave on 13 November hit 205 more hosts at 41 organisations. Huntress tied the access to the third-party RMM+ extension, whose versions 1.0.31 and 1.0.32 accepted a blank access key, and ConnectWise disabled five related extensions across hosted partner environments.

incidents.title: Stolen Qubole credentials used to access dozens of customers' AWS environments; n0n claims and leaks data
incidents.vector: compromised Qubole IAM credentials used to assume cross-account AWS roles
incidents.summary: Between 14 and 26 October attackers used compromised IAM credentials tied to cloud data platform Qubole to assume cross-account roles in dozens of downstream customers' AWS environments and download S3 data, according to Wiz, Sentra and Mandiant. The n0n extortion group claimed the intrusion on 11 November, alleging 53.9 GB stolen from Qubole itself, and on 16 November named 59 organisations on its leak site and began releasing data. Qubole and Idera have not commented, and its link to the JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard vendor breaches is unconfirmed.

updates.text: n0n claims responsibility for the Qubole intrusion
n0n names 59 organisations on its leak site, including JPMorgan Chase, Visa and Mastercard, and starts leaking data

incidents.title: Access Dental Management breach exposes SSNs and health data of more than 341,000 people
incidents.summary: Texas-based dental service organisation Access Dental Management said an unauthorised person may have viewed and copied data from its network between 1 and 4 May 2026, including names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, medical and health insurance information. It notified the Vermont and Texas attorneys general on 12 and 13 November of 341,049 affected people; the Texas filing reportedly lists 455,888 in total. The WorldLeaks extortion group listed the company on its leak site on 5 June.

incidents.title: Woolworths investigates drained digital WISH gift cards
incidents.vector: unknown; unauthorised redemption of digital gift cards
incidents.summary: Dozens of Woolworths customers reported that balances on digital Everyday WISH gift cards bought through the Everyday Rewards website or app were drained by transactions they did not make, with losses of up to A$500, ABC News reported on 16 November. Woolworths acknowledged an issue affecting a number of e-gift cards, apologised and began issuing replacement cards, but has not said how card details were obtained or whether its systems were breached.

incidents.title: Nitori says up to 37.62 million personal records may have leaked after unauthorised access
incidents.summary: Japanese furniture retailer Nitori Holdings confirmed unauthorised access to a system it manages on 6 November and said up to 37.62 million personal records held on its servers may have leaked, including member and purchaser names, email and postal addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth, corporate member contacts and order data from Nitori Net and its official marketplace shops. Credit card data and login passwords were not included, and the investigation found the attacker may also have accessed the system from mid to late October.

incidents.title: Vanderbilt University hit by ransomware attack claimed by BYOD
incidents.summary: Vanderbilt University told students and staff on 9 November to shut down university devices and disconnect from campus Wi-Fi while it responded to an active cybersecurity incident, then restored systems in stages. The BYOD ransomware group claimed it encrypted the university's databases and stole data including more than one million Social Security numbers; the university has not confirmed the claim.

updates.text: Former student files proposed class-action lawsuit over the breach

incidents.title: Maersk confirms data extraction from legacy system of acquired LF Logistics as WhiteArmor demands $5 million
incidents.vector: unauthorised access to inherited legacy system
incidents.summary: Maersk said on 11 November it found unauthorised access and data extraction from a local legacy system inherited through an earlier acquisition, adding that its findings so far suggest no sensitive data was disclosed and operations are not affected. The WhiteArmor group, which listed Maersk on its leak site on 7 November, claims about 100 GB from the former LF Logistics platform, including roughly 29,000 driver records and 16,000 staff accounts, and demands $5 million in bitcoin; Maersk has not confirmed those details.
